text: Use conflict as a ritual of jointly burning illusions. For this, the ability to consciously live through emotions while simultaneously being in a meta-position is important - without losing either of these two supports. In this state, the essence of the technique is quite simple - when a quarrel arises, stop seeing it as a problem. Perceive it as a sacred fire in which both of you can burn your false expectations, your selfish demands, your habitual masks. The task is not to win, and not even to find a compromise... but to come out of this fire purer, more open, and closer than you were before. Besides, it is interesting to learn to apply such magical techniques.
